headline_finding: V2.1 PASSED all 5 pre-registered criteria. Sensor dropout weakness FIXED (7.51h → 24.0h, 5/5 seeds) with ZERO regression on other 8 attacks. Failure mechanism precisely characterized: PI controller drives alpha toward 1.0 when p_obs=0, rate limiter can't prevent over-drainage when sensors return. V2.1 fix: sensor-health detector + safe fallback (freeze alpha during dropout). V2.1 is now the bench-validation candidate.

findings: Dropout threshold: between 10s and 30s. V2 survives 10s, fails at 30s+.
Controller state during dropout: alpha climbs from 0.1 to ~2.6 (mean across 4 segments) during 60s dropout. PI controller sees p_obs=0, opens valves fully.
Why rate limiter is harmful: allows alpha to climb from 0.1 to 1.0 over ~45s. When sensors return, alpha=1.0 causes massive over-drainage → ICP crashes → cumulative violation → failure at 7.5h.
Safe fallback state: alpha should HOLD at last known good value during dropout, NOT climb toward 1.0.
Maximum allowable stale-sensor interval: 10s (V2's survival threshold). V2.1 target: 300+s.

criteria: C2: V2.1 wins >= 4/5 seeds vs V2 (7.51h)
C3: V2.1 peak <= 25 mmHg under dropout
C4: V2.1 no regression on noise_3x (>= 20h)
C5: V2.1 no regression on 7 other attacks (>= 80% of V2)

details.C5: 100% of V2 on all 7 other attacks (threshold 80%) → PASS
